decision.note: Current Kew accepts O. engelmannii and six varieties. The project's local canonical entry O. engelmannii var. lindheimeri already represents the principal Central Texas learner concept. Retain species-level O. engelmannii as a searchable parent concept, not a second counted canonical species.

learner_guardrail: Do not create duplicate canonical taxa from parent names, synonyms, or stale infraspecific concepts. Current accepted concept and project counting unit control installation.
